limits: Four fresh processes; paired mean of process medians is a component diagnostic, not an end-user distribution.
All process medians/p95 and both nearest AB/BA pair deltas are retained; short within-process p95 is not used to dismiss or establish repeated material median regressions.
First connection has only1/3 correlated observations per process. Reconnect measures audience replacement and reports final-repetition per-client bytes.
Additional candidate SSE bootstrap work is explicit; compiled initial/render cost remains unmeasured.
